components.name: Prism Lens
components.blurb: A lens that only sings for those born in it. For anyone else it is a flashlight with ideas.
components.quirk: A beam 67% stronger than a Heat Lance's (5 a second for 1.5 s, piercing a cell), but at full strength only with a Prismatic manning it; anyone else gets half. Prismatics also add power.

components.name: Refractor
components.blurb: A crystal head that turns one shot into a scatter of them. Beautiful, brittle, and quiet when the ion comes.
components.quirk: Shard splinters: two cells beside the hit take damage too, so a shot does half as much again. Neon line: ion-weak, the shield-splitting trick is not built yet.

components.name: Glimmer Turret
components.blurb: A floating crystal that watches. It will only look where a crystal-born looks.
components.quirk: The most accurate turret there is (85%, quick to track), but it fires at only 40% rate unless a Prismatic mans it.
